tips.title: Dental Health Tips
tips.subtitle: Learn best practices for maintaining healthy teeth and preventing dental caries

hygiene.title: Oral Hygiene Best Practices
tips: Brush your teeth at least twice a day for two minutes each time
Use fluoride toothpaste to strengthen enamel
Floss daily to remove plaque between teeth
Rinse with an antibacterial mouthwash
Replace your toothbrush every 3-4 months

brushing.title: Proper Brushing Techniques
tips: Hold your brush at a 45-degree angle to your gums
Use gentle, short strokes
Brush all surfaces: outer, inner, and chewing surfaces
Don't forget to brush your tongue
Avoid brushing too hard as it can damage enamel

diet.title: Diet & Nutrition for Healthy Teeth
tips: Limit sugary and acidic foods and drinks
Drink plenty of water throughout the day
Eat calcium-rich foods like dairy, leafy greens
Include crunchy fruits and vegetables in your diet
Avoid snacking frequently between meals

prevention.title: Preventive Dental Care
tips: Visit your dentist for regular check-ups every 6 months
Get professional dental cleanings
Ask about dental sealants for cavity protection
Consider fluoride treatments if recommended
Address dental issues early before they worsen
